title: Vulak`Aerr ring event
summary: Survive the long Vulak ring through successive waves, split enemies and the final dragon.
overview: Survive the long Vulak ring through successive waves, split enemies and the final dragon.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Keep sustained add control and remain in the arena throughout the ring.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The controller starts its first stage one minute after activation and continues a timed multiwave sequence.
Several enemies split on death, and selected wave bosses trigger nearby player recovery.
Player deaths can create carrion enemies during the active portions of the event.
The final stage summons Vulak. The controller checks for non-feigned players in the arena and cleans up if the area is abandoned.

notes: Approval E346. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
This entry covers the scripted ring, not the separate fabled lockout-only variant.
